state.context: Miu World (online 3D learning game, 100% AI-built, owner only plays and reports bugs) is changing its testing: about 10 always-green E2E core flows that block deploy, a fast Node audit that every quest step target is reachable and not shadowed by another interactable, and phone/iPad screenshots of main screens reviewed by AI vision before each deploy. The plan has 7 phases; these are its open technical questions.
facts: reach-audit takes about 3.8 s per map; there are 12 maps; content:check runs on every push and before each deploy.
26 E2E specs, 114 tests; 60 CI runs on main red in a row; one shard always stopped at maxFailures 10 so 8 tests never ran.

The proposed smoke set: 11 flows, 13 tests (sign in, open a map, interact, finish a quest, fight a boss, buy, print a worksheet, plus build safety (public repo, no quest answers in the bundle), textbook exercise types by touch, online party play, Home on a phone). A leaner option is 9 flows, 11 tests.
Pets, voice chat and voice messages have server-side Node tests already.
Screenshots go into assets/generated/review/ and must be listed in the manifest; the repo is public on GitHub.
Staging exists (lab machine) and production (shared server); both deploy with their own deploy.sh.
A nightly CI run opens every map in E2E (E2E_ALL_MAPS=1); the new Node audit would check every map on every push.
Owner north star: lively, never boring; the owner wants bugs caught before they play, not long waits.

audit-place.instructions: Where should the quest target audit run?

criteria.in-content-check: Inside pnpm content:check when the whole audit runs in 30 s or less; split it into its own step only if slower.
criteria.separate-step: Always its own CI step and gate command, outside content:check.

commit-screens.instructions: Should the phone/iPad screenshots be committed at each deploy?

criteria.commit-overwrite: Yes: overwrite the same file names each time, captured at device scale 1, listed in the manifest, so the review page shows the latest.
criteria.artifact-only: No: keep them as CI artifacts and in the scratch folder, never committed.

gate-staging.instructions: Should the new deploy gate (green CI for the commit, screenshots reviewed, no code change since) apply to staging too?

criteria.both: Yes: one release-gate script used by both staging and production deploy.sh, with a force variable for urgent hotfixes.

smoke-size.instructions: How large should the deploy-blocking E2E smoke set be?

criteria.nine-flows: 9 flows, 11 tests (drop build safety E2E, kept by the security:dist script, and Home on a phone, covered by the screenshot review).

drop-pets-voice.instructions: Should pets, voice chat and voice messages leave the deploy-blocking E2E set?

criteria.drop: Yes: their server logic already has Node tests; the screenshot review covers their screens.
criteria.keep: No: keep one E2E each in the blocking set.

real-bugs-in-dropped.instructions: When triage finds a real bug inside a test that is being dropped, what should this delivery do?

criteria.log-fix-if-smoke: Record it on the roadmap and review page; fix it in this plan only if it lies on a smoke flow.
criteria.fix-all: Fix every real bug found during triage inside this plan, whatever flow it is on.

nightly-all-maps.instructions: Should the nightly E2E that opens every map be removed?

criteria.remove: Yes: the Node audit checks every map on every push.
criteria.keep: No: keep the nightly all-maps E2E as an extra net.
